marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind west 15 knots increasing to northwest 25 near midnight and
to northwest 30 early Thursday morning. Snow. Visibility as low as 1 mile in
snow. Temperatures plus 3 falling to minus 2 Thursday
evening. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 metre building to 2 late overnight then subsiding to 1
Thursday evening.<br/>
